blurb: Performance Tours Rafting offers whitewater rafting adventures on several Colorado rivers including the Arkansas River, Blue River, and Royal Gorge. Trips range from family-friendly floats to advanced class IV+ rapids. Full day trips include lunch and last about 6 hours total with 4 hours on the river; half day trips last about 4 hours with 2 hours on the river.
